derivation: Five lines. 'ld.lld: error: undefined symbol: helper(int)' is the host link's lld line with no place: one error, file, line, and column null, code null, the message the text after 'ld.lld: error: '. The two lines that start with '>>> ' are lld's context (the source file main.hip named by the object, then the host object under the capture's workdir, @lassi-tmp/main-8098dc.o, in main), so no diagnostic. 'clang++: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)' is a clang driver line with no place: one error, the message the text after 'clang++: error: '. The last line, 'failed to execute:' and the clang++ command hipcc ran, is hipcc's own report of the failed clang call, so nothing. No line is in GNU ld's format.
